clues.easy: Temp ħażin b’riħ jew xita qawwija

words.meaning: Perjodu ta’ temp qawwi li jista’ jġib riħ, xita, ragħad u beraq.
words.exampleEnglish: The storm knocked down several branches.

words.meaning: Riħ ħafif u pjaċevoli li jonfoħ bil-mod.
words.exampleEnglish: A cool breeze came through the window.

clues.easy: Turi kemm hu sħun jew kiesaħ

words.meaning: Il-kejl ta’ kemm xi ħaġa, l-arja jew il-ġisem huma sħan jew kesħin.
words.exampleEnglish: The temperature dropped during the night.

words.meaning: Il-jum li għadda minnufih qabel il-jum tal-lum.
words.exampleEnglish: Yesterday we went to the seaside.

words.meaning: Il-parti tal-jum bejn wara nofsinhar u l-lejl.
words.exampleEnglish: In the evening we sit together in the kitchen.

words.meaning: L-ewwel parti jew il-punt minn fejn tibda xi ħaġa.
words.exampleEnglish: The beginning of the book was interesting.

words.meaning: L-aħħar parti jew il-punt fejn tieqaf jew tintemm xi ħaġa.
words.exampleEnglish: At last we reached the end of the road.

words.meaning: Perjodu qasir ħafna ta’ żmien jew punt partikolari fih.
words.exampleEnglish: Wait a moment while I open the door.

clues.easy: Annimal kbir magħruf bħala s-sultan tal-ġungla

words.meaning: Annimal selvaġġ kbir tal-familja tal-qtates; ir-raġel għandu kriniera.
words.exampleEnglish: The lion roared loudly.

words.meaning: Annimal selvaġġ kbir tal-familja tal-qtates, magħruf għall-pil oranġjo bi strixxi suwed.
words.exampleEnglish: The tiger moved quietly among the trees.

clues.easy: Annimal kbir u b’saħħtu b’ħafna suf

words.meaning: Annimal kbir u b’saħħtu b’ġisem miksi bil-pil, denb qasir u dwiefer b’saħħithom.
words.exampleEnglish: The bear searched for food in the forest.

clues.easy: Annimal magħruf għal denbu twil u l-għaqal

words.meaning: Annimal selvaġġ b’geddum irqiq, widnejn bil-ponta u denb twil u folt.
words.exampleEnglish: The fox came out of its den at night.

clues.easy: Annimal li jitla’ mas-siġar u jixbah lill-bniedem

words.meaning: Annimal intelliġenti b’idejn li jaqbdu u li ħafna speċi tiegħu jgħixu fis-siġar.
words.example: Ix-xadina qabżet minn fergħa għal oħra.
words.exampleEnglish: The monkey jumped from one branch to another.

clues.easy: Annimal bi strixxi suwed u bojod

words.meaning: Annimal Afrikan jixbah liż-żiemel u għandu strixxi suwed u bojod.
words.exampleEnglish: The zebra ran with the herd.

words.meaning: Annimal Afrikan għoli ħafna b’għonq twil u pil imtebba’.
words.exampleEnglish: The giraffe reached the high leaves.

clues.easy: Annimal kbir b’widnejn kbar u mnieħer twil

words.meaning: Annimal tal-art kbir ħafna b’widnejn kbar, nejbiet u tromba twila.
words.exampleEnglish: The elephant drank water with its trunk.

words.meaning: Annimal żgħir li dahru miksi bix-xewk u li jingħalaq f’ballun biex jiddefendi ruħu.
words.exampleEnglish: The hedgehog hid under the leaves.

words.meaning: Insett b’żewġ pari ġwienaħ kbar u spiss ikkuluriti li jiżviluppa minn dudu.
words.exampleEnglish: The butterfly landed on the flower.

clues.easy: Ħlejqa bi tmien saqajn li tinseġ xibka

words.meaning: Ħlejqa żgħira bi tmien saqajn li ħafna drabi tagħmel xibka biex taqbad l-ikel.
words.exampleEnglish: The spider spun a web in the corner.

words.meaning: Rettilu b’ġisem twil u bla saqajn li jimxi billi jiżżerżaq mal-art.
words.exampleEnglish: The snake slid between the rocks.

words.meaning: Il-forma żgħira taż-żrinġ li tgħix fl-ilma, għandha denb u għadha bla saqajn fil-bidu.
words.exampleEnglish: The tadpole was swimming in the pond.

clues.easy: Annimal tal-baħar b’qoxra u żewġ imqassijiet

words.meaning: Annimal tal-baħar b’qoxra iebsa, diversi saqajn u żewġ dwiefer kbar bħal imqassijiet.
words.exampleEnglish: The crab walked sideways on the sand.

words.meaning: Annimal żgħir tal-baħar b’ġisem irqiq, qoxra u saqajn żgħar.
words.exampleEnglish: The shrimp lives in the sea.

words.meaning: Sport bejn żewġ timijiet li jippruvaw idaħħlu ballun fix-xibka tal-avversarju, l-aktar bis-saqajn.
words.exampleEnglish: The children played football in the playground.

clues.easy: Sport b’rakketta u ballun fuq xibka

words.meaning: Sport li fih il-plejers jolqtu ballun b’rakketta minn fuq xibka.
words.exampleEnglish: They played tennis on the new court.

words.meaning: L-attività jew l-isport li fih persuna timxi fl-ilma billi ċċaqlaq dirgħajha u saqajha.
words.exampleEnglish: Swimming helps strengthen the body.

words.meaning: Moviment mgħaġġel bis-saqajn li fih il-ġisem javvanza aktar malajr mill-mixi.
words.exampleEnglish: Morning running gives him energy.

clues.easy: Moviment minn post għal ieħor bis-saqajn

words.meaning: Moviment minn post għal ieħor billi tagħmel passi bis-saqajn.
words.exampleEnglish: The walk in the countryside was pleasant.

words.meaning: Moviment tal-ġisem skont ritmu jew mużika, għall-gost, l-arti jew ċelebrazzjoni.
words.exampleEnglish: The dancing began as soon as the music played.

words.meaning: L-att li bih persuna tuża leħinha biex tagħmel melodija jew kanzunetta.
words.exampleEnglish: The choir’s singing filled the theatre.

words.meaning: Ħsejjes organizzati f’ritmu, melodija u armonija biex joħolqu forma ta’ arti.
words.exampleEnglish: The music was sweet and cheerful.

clues.easy: Storja murija bi stampi li jiċċaqalqu

words.meaning: Storja jew xogħol viżiv magħmul minn stampi li jiċċaqalqu u ħoss.
words.exampleEnglish: We watched a Maltese film at the cinema.

clues.easy: Attività li ssir għall-gost jew kompetizzjoni

words.meaning: Attività b’regoli li ssir għall-gost, it-tagħlim jew il-kompetizzjoni.
words.exampleEnglish: The game lasted an hour.

words.meaning: Post b’tobba, infermiera u tagħmir fejn jiġu kkurati persuni morda jew midruba.
words.exampleEnglish: They took him to hospital for treatment.

words.meaning: Bini li joffri kmamar u servizzi lil vjaġġaturi jew turisti għal żmien qasir.
words.exampleEnglish: They stayed in a hotel near the sea.

clues.easy: Post fejn jitħejja u jittiekel l-ikel

words.meaning: Post fejn jitħejja u jiġi servut l-ikel lill-klijenti biex jieklu hemmhekk.
words.exampleEnglish: We ate at a small restaurant in the city.

clues.easy: Post fejn jintwerew oġġetti storiċi jew artistiċi

words.meaning: Post li jiġbor, iħares u juri oġġetti storiċi, artistiċi, xjentifiċi jew kulturali.
words.example: Il-mużew kellu kollezzjoni ta’ fdalijiet antiki.
words.exampleEnglish: The museum had a collection of ancient remains.

clues.easy: Post fejn jittellgħu drammi u wirjiet

words.meaning: Bini bi palk u siġġijiet fejn jittellgħu drammi, kunċerti u wirjiet.
words.exampleEnglish: We watched a play at the theatre.

clues.easy: Post b’ħafna kotba għall-qari jew self

words.meaning: Post li jiġbor kotba u materjal ieħor għall-qari, l-istudju jew is-self.
words.exampleEnglish: She borrowed a book from the library.

words.meaning: Kamra jew post fejn isir xogħol amministrattiv, professjonali jew kummerċjali.
words.exampleEnglish: The office opens at eight.

words.meaning: Bini fejn ħaddiema u magni jipproduċu jew jiġbru oġġetti fuq skala kbira.
words.exampleEnglish: The factory produces furniture.

clues.easy: Post rurali fejn jitrabbew annimali jew jitkabbru prodotti

words.meaning: Post rurali b’art u bini fejn jitkabbru prodotti agrikoli jew jitrabbew l-annimali.
words.example: Fir-razzett jitkabbru l-ħaxix u jitrabbew it-tiġieġ.
words.exampleEnglish: Vegetables are grown and chickens are raised on the farm.

words.meaning: Ħanut jew post tas-saħħa fejn jitħejjew u jinbiegħu mediċini u jingħata parir dwarhom.
words.exampleEnglish: She bought the medicine from the pharmacy.
